title: Verify Parts Manager can create, edit, and delete a vendor
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Manager role. (this role has Vendor and Order Management: View/Create and Edit/Delete).
steps:
1. Click Vendors in the main navigation.
2. Click to add a new vendor, fill in the vendor name, and save.
3. Open the vendor, change a field, and save.
4. Delete the vendor and confirm.
expected: The vendor can be created, edited, and deleted with no permission errors.
